source_identity.source_digest_basis: git archive tar stream at immutable revision
source_identity.working_tree_note: The existing donor checkout is dirty, but this package addresses the immutable commit archive and does not copy or rely on uncommitted files.

rights_boundary.applications: AGPL-3.0 with Teable Section 7 brand-protection terms
rights_boundary.packages: Retain each package's own notices; no package source is copied here
rights_boundary.branding: Teable name, logo, icons and visual identity remain unchanged
rights_boundary.network_source_obligation: Any network-served modified donor build needs a corresponding-source decision and applicable notices

dependency_closure_note: The pinned donor build was observed healthy, but this block has not independently captured a transitive dependency closure receipt; do not infer closure from the build receipt.
normalization_not_applied: NS-TOKEN-01: not applicable to a cross-origin/intact service; a proxy cannot inherit donor CSS variables
NS-TENANT-01: not applicable to the donor service shape; the host proxy must enforce the verified tenant boundary
NS-MIGRATE-01: not applicable to source absorption; donor migration state remains donor-owned

metadata.schema: public at the pinned V2 source

donor_migration_ownership.invariant: No two owners may migrate or mutate the same resource through separate histories.

one_server_separate_schema_compatibility.server: one PostgreSQL server/database may host donor metadata, donor-generated base schemas and host-owned schemas
one_server_separate_schema_compatibility.schema_separation: Teable metadata stays in public at this pinned source because V2 raw SQL hard-codes public; host-owned data stays in a separate non-public schema; each Teable base owns its generated schema
one_server_separate_schema_compatibility.required_privilege: The donor role needs CONNECT and CREATE on the database plus ownership/DDL rights for donor-created schemas; do not grant the host migration role donor ownership
one_server_separate_schema_compatibility.compatibility_status: declared_for_prototype; privilege and independent restore proof remain open

source_handling.runtimeReference: Existing SISOCRM Teable runtime/source precedent; host supplies the actual sidecar URL
